common_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a polished 16:9 landscape thumbnail for a Vietnamese school game catalog, full bleed, no border. Match the attached reference's rich hand-drawn chibi cartoon art and integrated Vietnamese title lettering: oversized rounded inflated glossy letters, yellow-orange first line and cyan-blue second line, very dark thick inner contour, thick white sticker outline, offset dimensional shadow, white highlights, expressive children in white school shirts and red scarves, rich bright colors, playful rays/sparkles and layered foreground/background. This is an illustrated game cover, not a UI screenshot. Main title must dominate the upper central 45-55% and be perfectly legible at small card size, supporting illustrated scene fills lower half, with characters around edges. Keep 5% safe margins for all lettering and faces. No browser UI, no logos, no watermark, no extra text other than the exact title and short subtitle specified. A cohesive family matching the reference, while all objects and scenery fit THIS game's theme. Generate a brand new cover; input image is style reference only.
